record.statement: IIT predicts that the neural substrate of consciousness (PSC/complex) corresponds to elements with maximum intrinsic cause–effect power, locating the content-specific NCC in the neural elements of the PSC rather than in prefrontal or other regions, consistent with a posterior cortical hot zone.
